text: This report sets out the use of delegated authority during City Council's recess during the 2018 municipal election to direct the Chief Planner to attend at Toronto Local Appeal Board Hearings on appeals of Committee of Adjustment decisions or to appeal a Committee of Adjustment decision on behalf of the City.
City Council on February 26, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (January 21, 2019) from the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning for information.
